name: EMOM
description: Every minute on the minute, do the set reps and rest for what is left of the minute.

name: AMRAP
description: As many rounds as possible of a short circuit within a fixed time.

name: Ladder
description: Repeat a circuit with the reps per exercise following a fixed descending or pyramid scheme.

name: Tabata
description: Eight rounds of 20 seconds all-out work and 10 seconds rest on one exercise.

name: Timed stations
description: Rotate through stations with fixed work and rest intervals for one or more laps.
